motion.$description: Short, decelerating and without bounce by default. Springs are given as a duration (time to settle) and a bounce; the build turns them into CSS easing curves.

default.$description: Most layout changes: accordions, cards settling, panels resizing.

expressive.$description: Only when a dragged card is dropped and for success confirmations.

exit.$description: Leaving the screen: starts at once and accelerates.

decelerate.$description: Entering elements that are not springs, such as panels.

standard.$description: Continuous transforms such as the sidebar folding.

accelerate.$description: Panels and sheets leaving: starts slow and leaves at speed.

emphasized.$description: The theme switch’s knob and cards moving between columns.

crossfade.$description: The page cross-fading from one theme to the other.

duration.$description: Fixed timings of particular moments, read from the product. Springs above stay the default for anything else.

state.$description: Hover and pressed colors of rows, pills and buttons, with easing.decelerate.

panel-enter.$description: A side panel or a phone sheet arriving: its slide uses the spatial default spring stretched to this time.

panel-exit.$description: A side panel leaving: 28 px and out of sight, with easing.accelerate.

sheet-fade.$description: A phone sheet’s opacity while it rises.

sheet-exit.$description: A phone sheet going down, with easing.accelerate.

menu-exit.$description: A menu closing to 96 %, with easing.exit.

dropdown.$description: The search results opening, with easing.decelerate.

tooltip-delay.$description: The pointer rests this long before a tooltip opens.

tooltip-enter.$description: A tooltip opening from 96 %, with easing.decelerate.

tooltip-exit.$description: A tooltip fading out, with easing.exit.

theme.$description: The cross-fade of the whole page when the theme changes, with easing.crossfade.

theme-fallback.$description: Color transitions when a browser cannot cross-fade the page.

reflow.$description: Cards moving to new places when the number of columns changes, with easing.emphasized.
